text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Speak your mind!

The calls of the Zen riddle echo. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I put a question to thee! Once I 
have achieved my revolution—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Can I defend my era, and leave my running 
behind for future generations!?"
—It was a heavy, perplexing question.

"To preserve No Reason's running for 
future generations." That was the original 
reason for raising our banner. And yet...

Whether it can truly be accomplished or 
not...
(T-Tick tick tick tick...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Have you found your answer, Trainer?

I spent a sleepless night thinking it 
through... And finally, I've got it all 
sorted out.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Then tell me. Will my running... leave 
its mark on future generations?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Can they leave a mark, or not!?
(T-Tick tick tick tick...)

The chirping of little sparrows playing 
innocently echoed emptily.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "...I see. And your reason?"
choice_data_list:
Everyone else around me is just way too 
strong...

text_block_list.text:
It went without saying. It was truly a 
chaotic, fiercely competitive Warring 
States era of rivals. And emerging as the 
sole victor among them—

Running in a way that illuminates the 
three thousand worlds is no easy feat. To 
prevail in these turbulent times is simply 
too...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufufu...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What an honest fellow! My answer is the 
exact same, Trainer! Nwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"You expect me to survive against this 
entire army all on my own?" "Don't speak 
such foolishness!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: No, or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Had my comrades-in-arms been there, 
perhaps it might have been possible.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps it is my comrades-in-arms who 
are meant to preserve our running. That, 
too, has its own charm...

There was every possibility. Yet now, 
every single path is closing shut.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Very well! In that case, by all means! 
Fight flashily, fight and fight, and then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Shall we scatter like petals, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
With thee by my side, I shall not be 
lonely. For after all...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
After all, it is because we met someone we 
could trust from the bottom of our hearts 
that we made it this far.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Under normal circumstances, I feel I 
would have been struck down somewhere long 
ago. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I was able to make it this far! I have not 
a single regret.

There was no regret in No Reason's eyes. 
If anything—

"Like a young boy who had played his heart 
out. However..."
choice_data_list: It's still... too early to fall.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?
choice_data_list: It's too early to scatter, No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet now that we have exhausted all our 
options, what on earth are we supposed to 
do?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What more... am I supposed to run for...?

One may overturn the realm and yet fail to 
hold it. However—

"Even if only for a brief moment, we can 
show the world that the tides of time have 
truly turned!"
choice_data_list:
Let's take a total victory in the "Japan 
Cup"!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A complete victory... Even if... it's a 
victory with no tomorrow?
choice_data_list: Yes, even if there is no tomorrow.
Yeah, even if there's no tomorrow.

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's only for a fleeting moment, 
as long as No Reason is fierce as an 
Asura, that is enough.

If I am to be the fierce Shogun who stands 
before the next era...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The Great Shogun... who stands in the path 
of the next era...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowa-hahaha! Well said, Trainer, well said 
indeed~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even if it amounts to nothing in 
the end, huh.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then, Trainer, allow me to show 
you.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Our once-in-a-lifetime run!! Yes, running 
our hearts out—
choice_data_list: Yeah, we don't need a reason!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's life is like grass and 
trees... Just something that happened to 
be born under the heavens.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Our lives may have no reason! Yet even 
without reason, we can shine!!
—The same day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hear me. My thoughts are—this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"A rogue is a rogue, no matter how you 
spin it." Looking at the current trends in 
racing—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"You must not try to be a role model. Nor 
should you try to emulate one."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Our running is "too heavy" to pass down to 
the next era.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And so, I simply vanish like the morning 
dew. That is enough.
Heh, to vanish like the dew—I see.

Kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh... If you say I must obey 
the Delphic Oracle—
—Nay!

Nay, nay, a thousand times nay. O 
exquisite beast.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"You say you don't want to disappear... Is 
that it, Tanino Gimlet?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you've already... What more could 
you possibly—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Falling into the abyss is fine. 
Eventually, we will return—to mother 
ocean. However—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To vanish in mere silence is laughably 
absurd! Indeed, the giant—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Collapsing with an earthquake that shakes 
the hemisphere, leaving in its wake a 
giant crater in the earth!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To embrace the heavenly rain. When 
falling, let it be—more fierce than anyone 
else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Fiercely... you say—?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I get it. I couldn't become the real 'me.' 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bearing that guilt in my heart... let us 
march. Straight into the crater of ruin.

I can hear... voices. The voices of 
commanders who failed to seize their era. 
However...

The festival is not over yet. A festival 
that colors the era we lived in.
